issues.description: The workflow's multiple commercial, author-local and public inputs have only metadata or source-name evidence. Required rows, permissions, product snapshots, field compatibility, join coverage and full sample history have not been verified; the four-forward-quarter construction may extend beyond 2019.
SAS 002 and SAS 008 read ICLINK data to assign PERMNO, but no producer or exact local path for `bjar.iclink` / `ic.iclink` is supplied. The mapping is not replaced by the separate IBES ID table.

SAS 008 reads `rdq_fyearq` and joins it by GVKEY, DATADATE, and RDQ to add FYEARQ/FQTR. No producer, deduplication rule, or exact history contract for that map is supplied; COMP.FUNDQ metadata is only an upstream candidate.

SAS 002 creates `bjar.master_file` and a `dbox.master_file` copy, while SAS 008 reads `dr.master_file` from a separate author Data root. The configured library mapping, exact file identity, and field compatibility across this handoff are unspecified.

SAS 002 consumes an author GVKEY-keyed RavenPack earnings table; nested SQL generation instead requires the sample-specific `projects.kb_sample_rp_entity_id` mapping. The generic RPA entity-mapping catalog candidate does not establish this sample join, its producer, or its effective dates.

Nested Python expects an author-prepared EDGAR sample DTA with `fname` filing references; no producer matching the SAS main sample or sample-ID list is supplied. The accession/filename mapping and exact sample period remain unknown.

The Python unbundler writes filing documents to one directory, while F# reads a distinct cleaned-input directory; the field-preserving cleaning, renaming and copy handoff is not supplied. The F# dictionaries are also absent from the five-member container.

R 011 requires `main_sample_KB_Controls_2021.dta` with CIK/PENDS and named text-control fields. None of the five nested programs produces this exact file or schema; per-filing measures and the separate media-coverage output do not establish the required combined table.

The authored stages mix SAS_EXECFILEPATH-relative output, author D: roots and Stata ..\Data roots. In particular SAS 009 to R 011, R 011 to Stata 012, Stata 012 to R 013, and R 013 to Stata 014 need one explicit shared output/current-directory configuration and exact path verification.

SAS sources require WRDS remote sessions, remote LIBNAMEs, local libraries, and author-specific roots. Runtime/license/SAS CONNECT availability and authorized account access are unverified; embedded author connection values were not used or reproduced.

The supplied F# preparation program is substantive code, but the bounded software metadata check found no .NET/F# runtime command. Runtime setup and the exact invocation remain to be prepared; no compile or execution was attempted.

SAS 005 reads bjar.crspdates to construct the NYSE/NASDAQ minute calendars, but none of the 14 supplied stages produces this table or identifies its exact author-prepared source. Its schema, date population, and route remain unverified. An author-prepared table or documented compatible construction remains the route to check; the absent producer does not establish unavailable CRSP access or a confirmed code blocker.

SAS 008 joins m.mv_20_bef on PERMNO and PR_DATE while building a control intermediate, but no supplied stage produces this table or specifies its measure fields and date coverage. An author-prepared input or documented compatible construction remains the route to verify. The missing producer is an unresolved input contract, not evidence that data or entitlement is unavailable.

evidence.quote:
In the paper, we examine a methodology change in the way quarterly earnings press releases
are processed in the I/B/E/S database. Therefore, our analyses are based on a sample of
quarterly earnings announcements obtained from the I/B/E/S academic database obtained
through Wharton Research Data Services (WRDS). Our analyses require precise earnings press
release timestamps, which we obtained from Wall St. Horizon data purchased by the University
of Maryland for the years 2006 – 2021. We also validate all press release timestamps using data
from the University of Miami’s standalone Ravenpack subscription (not purchased through
WRDS). To calculate text-based control variables (e.g., word counts) for each quarterly earnings
press release, we obtained the text of each earnings press release in our sample from 8-K filings
obtained via the SEC EDGAR system. We obtained additional WRDS data needed to construct
our variables from the Compustat, CRSP, I/B/E/S, TAQ, and Thomson Reuters CDA/Spectrum
evidence.description: The author data sheet names WRDS I/B/E/S, purchased Wall Street Horizon timestamps, standalone RavenPack, SEC EDGAR 8-K text, and Compustat/CRSP/IBES/TAQ/CDA Spectrum s34 sources.

use "..\Data\analyst_level_sample.dta", clear 

//generate the ana_first variable
gen ana_first = 1 if  analyst_cmin_delay < pr_lagmins
replace ana_first = 0 if  analyst_cmin_delay > pr_lagmins

//winsorize the continuous variables 
winsor2 gexp fexp analysts_employed mean_abs_fcast_error_act_w abs_fcast_error_prc abs_fcast_error_act_w n_ea_covered_5d, by(yearqtr) replace



//generate analyst-level variables
gen ln_analysts_employed=ln(analysts_employed)
gen ln_gexp=ln(gexp)
gen ln_fexp=ln(fexp)
